scope: Exact fchmodAt/fchownAt ABI data, checked byte/word decoding and inverse, same-operation resolved metadata target, and existing active-boundary/system-anchor authority consumers. No complete filesystem or public caller guarantee follows from this supporting record.
concrete_connection: NativeCallAuthorityTarget.path_iff forces a path setter to use NativePrimitive.pathTarget on the exact same token, caller, before/after native ledgers, projected worlds, operation, optional reply and committed product. The directory FD is never substituted for the resolved metadata target.
review: Both operations append constructors; old enum order and unrelated data groups remain under the separate explicit strict NativeCode amendment.
Raw path bytes and every mode, UID/GID and flags word are retained; out-of-range words/bytes reject before narrowing.
Errors/loss can retain a real resolved/committed target; no successful SDK return or future child birth is assumed.
Metadata exceptions and profile1 authority restrictions name the actual setter target at the same active boundary. No whole callback/private-region frame is introduced.
Full types and transitive axioms were queried in the pinned ordinary Lean kernel; no custom axiom, sorry or compiler reduction shortcut was found.
remaining: Actual C/SDK per-operation NativeCode binder and same global NativeCallAt producer remain root-owned integration work.
Full source/native custody fold, private-key nonexposure and earlier committed-envelope provenance remain incomplete M5.2 obligations.
